title: Roberto Z NDE 4991
content: After fainting, I remember I was looking at the opposite wall. Suddenly, a fissure was opened from which a wonderful white enveloping light came. The crack widened and I felt drawn to it, while I could see myself covered in blood (I was looking from above) lying on the bed with no doctors around me. I saw blood on the floor. I felt I wanted to come across extremely strongly. Then I saw a doctor who was smacking me and he said I had to react to that. From that moment, I had as a start and I felt back in my body. Everything I had seen vanished, all that remained was my aching body and a great cold! Then I woke up. The doctors asked me how I was. I told them I felt cold. They made me an injection and said I would feel better, and then I fell asleep. I woke up the next day (I was very ill). I remained twenty days without food and had several transfusions. I was discharged after thirty-five days and never told anyone this story (only my wife and my son).
